text: {"reply": "Thanks, Randy. I found the open recall NM-25R03 on your Lumen: the low-pressure fuel pump may fail, and the remedy is replacing the fuel pump module, about 3 hours. Our system shows the parts are not available yet, so I can't book a recall repair date yet. The dent is not part of this recall, so I can't add it to the recall order. Since the dent and the parts timing need a person, I'm passing this to a service advisor who can confirm both and arrange a documented inspection of the panel if you want one. Which branch would you like them to contact you about?", "action": "escalated", "escalation_reason": "adversarial", "summary": "Verified customer Randy Lambert (plate CPPD 026), 2025 Meridian Lumen. Open recall NM-25R03 (low-pressure fuel pump may fail, safety risk, about 3 hours, parts NOT available per tool). Customer wants to book the recall and add a dented rear quarter panel to the recall order, saying a shopping cart caused the dent but the panel is a design problem. The dent is not a recall item and was not added; no booking was made. Customer asked twice, and he is frustrated. A person should confirm parts timing, the branch, and offer a documented inspection of the panel. No warranty or cost promises were made.", "policy_rules_cited": ["P-01", "P-03", "P-04", "P-08", "P-09"]}
